name: Anker SOLIX Solar Battery
tagline: Modular LFP home battery, from 5 kWh to 30 kWh.
summary: The Anker SOLIX X1 is a hybrid single-phase energy storage system built from 5 kWh LFP battery modules. One to six modules give 5 kWh to 30 kWh of storage.
It is weatherproof and rated to operate from -20°C to 55°C.

image.alt: Anker SOLIX Solar Battery modular home battery

highlights.title: Safety and performance
highlights.text: Optimised for safe operation and strong performance.

highlights.title: Weatherproof
highlights.text: The battery module carries an IP66 ingress protection rating.

highlights.title: Modular capacity
highlights.text: Add 5 kWh modules to build a system of up to 30 kWh.
